reasoning_content: So the issue is that `ki-guv-feedback` declares `psycopg2-binary` in its dependencies, but when `create_engine` is called with a `postgresql://` URL, SQLAlchemy is trying to import the psycopg v3 module instead of psycopg2. The `psycopg_url` configuration is building a `postgresql://` URL, which triggers this import attempt.
